description: This source file implements the 'Stop' task for the WebAudio component in the Rialto server, responsible for stopping the WebAudio pipeline by changing its state to NULL.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A class representing the task to stop the WebAudio pipeline.

methods.name: Stop::Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with a reference to the WebAudio player.

methods.description: Executes the stop operation by changing the pipeline state to NULL.
